subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly with China Southern Airlines via Guangzhou into northwest and north China for the Danxia landforms of Jingbian Wave Valley, the Yellow River’s Hukou Waterfall, Yunqiu Mountain’s ice caves and the World Heritage city of Pingyao. Six nights in 4-star hotels, 11 listed meals, a private bus and an English-speaking guide. A no-shopping package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 6–12 2026 to Jun 25–Jul 1 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Zhenbeitai: A large Ming-dynasty watchtower near Yulin, known as the first watchtower of the Great Wall.
placeDesc.Jingbian Wave Valley: A Danxia landform of wavy, layered rock in Shaanxi, visited with an elevator and glass bridge.
placeDesc.Baota Mountain: A hill in Yan’an crowned by an old pagoda, visited with a sightseeing cart included.
placeDesc.Ganquan Yucha Grand Canyon: A Danxia canyon on the Loess Plateau that looks like a deep earth fissure, with a shuttle bus included.
placeDesc.Hukou Waterfall: A broad waterfall on the Yellow River where the river narrows and drops, on the Shanxi side.
placeDesc.Yunqiu Mountain: A mountain scenic area in Shanxi with cliff-side temples, villages and caves, with interval shuttles included.
placeDesc.Ta’erpo Ancient Village: A traditional village built into the slopes of Yunqiu Mountain in Shanxi.
placeDesc.Yunqiu Mountain Ice Cave: A cluster of caves on Yunqiu Mountain that stay icy, reached by electric cart.
placeDesc.Feihong Pagoda: A tall glazed pagoda at Guangsheng Temple in Shanxi, a filming location of Black Myth: Wukong.
placeDesc.Guangsheng Temple: An old Buddhist temple near Hongdong in Shanxi, home of the Feihong Pagoda.
placeDesc.Shuanglin Temple: A temple near Pingyao known for its collection of painted clay sculptures.
placeDesc.Pingyao Ancient City: A walled Ming-era town in Shanxi, a UNESCO World Heritage site, explored with an electric cart.
placeDesc.Ming-Qing Street: The main street of Pingyao Ancient City, where guests try a Shanxi merchant costume makeover.
placeDesc.Jinci Park: An ancient temple complex and garden near Taiyuan, with museum tickets not included.
placeDesc.Shuangzuo Temple: Also called the Twin Pagoda Temple, a Taiyuan landmark with two tall pagodas.
placeDesc.Liuxiang: An old lane area in Taiyuan with shops and eateries, with free time for the group.
placeDesc.Zhonglou Street: A pedestrian shopping street near Taiyuan's Bell Tower, with free time for the group.
